t: This is the address of the International Council of Jurists, a company based in London. It organizes seminars and conferences here and in India, and it gives out awards. It charges fees for membership, conference sponsorship and advertising. Its founder and president is Adish Aggarwala, an Indian advocate and jurist who also served as chairman of the All India Bar Association. In April 2020 he put forward a conspiracy theory claiming that the Chinese had deliberately launched the COVID-19 pandemic. That claim is part of this organization's public record.
